Title: when window is scrolled; resize causes widgets to go nuts

Title: Crash in Dispatch event when switch documents
Description: This happends (on Wndows) because a focus event is coming through when the; window has already been deleted. I think the best fix for now is to just disable; the notification of focus events; these notifications are not currently being; used. The fix is will be in nsWindow.cpp

Title: row background painting not backwards compatible
Description: today we paint row backgrounds as a solid block; with cell backgrounds painting; over them.; Nav4 and IE treat row backgrounds as being inherited by the cells.; The visual difference is the space between cells gets the table background; rather than the row background.; CSS-2 seems to indicate we should do it the way were doing it today.; Ive added code to do this the Nav4 way; making sample 3 look correct.; We can easily add variant code to check which mode were in and do the correct; thing.

Title: table layout broken with nscoord-width columns and colspans
Description: whenever we have colspans; we have a rule that the space required by the; spanning cell is proportionately distributed to the column it spans; with the; percentage based on the required width of the columns as if colspans didnt; exist.  This rule has an exception:  whenever the widths of all the columns; involved are specified; the specified widths are used and the proportions are; never computed.

Title: images with no width attribute in tables dont work well
Description: whenever we have an image that doesnt have a specified width; and that image; is inside a table; the table will lay out incorrectly.  This is because we are; not computing the minimum required size of the cell containing the image; correctly during the incremental reflow that is generated once the image width; is known.

Title: a document that ends in text doesnt layout properly
Description: When you resize the window then it fixes it up.; ; Its because the flushing of text when closing the document isnt; trigger an appended reflow like it should.

Title: propagation error for tables
Description: backward propagation was not terminating at gating tags; such as <table>.; This would cause content to be ejected from the table when a <tr> was omitted; and the table was inside another container; such as a nested table or a table; inside a <div>.

Title: table assertion triggered when maxElementSize > desiredSize
Description: a floating image on this page reports its desired size to be less than its; maxElementSize.  Table code asserts that maxElementSize <= desiredSize.  Ive; fixed it so that the table cell always reserves at least the maxElementSize for; the content.
